source: Combined from MLB.com, ESPN, USA Today, NBC Sports, MLB Injury Report, FantraxHQ, Dodgers Nation, Dodger Blue, ClutchPoints, The Athletic, @MarkBowmanBSB, Dave Roberts pressers

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

injury.type: Grade 1 left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence this season)
injury.how: Strained hamstring running to first base; first occurrence was May 2025
injury.status: On 10-day IL; began FCL rehab assignment mid-July 2025 (0-for-3, 1 K). Expected return ~July 18, 2025. Home Run Derby availability in jeopardy.

pre_injury_stats.games: 53 (partial season at time of latest report)

players.notes: First injury-shortened 2025 season since 2023 ACL tear. Must progress through: FCL rehab → MLB activation. Monitor Braves beat reporters for Rehab Gate updates. Home Run Derby at risk.

players.name: Mookie Betts

injury.type: Right oblique strain (resolved — returned to lineup)
injury.how: Strained right oblique; line-up removal from games. Placed on 10-day IL for ~5 weeks.
injury.status: Activated from 10-day IL mid-July 2025. Completed 2 rehab games with OKC. Playing on load-managed schedule (3 games then rest).

players.notes: Lineup impact: Freeman moved to 2nd, Tucker to 4th, Betts to 3. Betts on 7-game hit streak (.355 over 15 games). Both Snell (Saturday) and Betts (Monday) returned within days. Manager Dave Roberts managing workload with planned rest days.

players.name: Freddie Freeman

injury.type: Left rib/scar tissue disruption (March 18, 2025 Tokyo Dome)
injury.how: Re-aggravated during BP before Tokyo Dome debut vs Cubs. Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo. Roberts: 'thought was scar tissue broke up during BP.' Freeman: '75% chance of playing tomorrow.'
injury.status: Resolved quickly. Currently active and playing regularly. Chronic left ankle managed with treatment and load management.

pre_injury_stats.prior_injury_context: 2024 postseason — played through ankle injury for World Series MVP performance (Walk-Off Grand Slam). 2025: leading MLB in softball grounds, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate.

players.return_timeline: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
players.notes: Rib/scar tissue scrape from Tokyo opener was minor and resolved. Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require monitoring. Hit legendary Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS despite right ankle sprain.
